name: Kororinpa
author: MarkyArchived
description: Time a click as player two around .8% to have your icon fall in the middle of the level. Play normally as player one while not having to play the player two section until 17%. Play normally from there. Spam player one hard from 38.7%-39% and then don’t click to only end up as player one and skip the following section whilst staying on the ceiling. Click a couple times at 49% to maintain a constant position slightly below the ceiling until 50% where you can do a couple quick clicks and then stay below the ceiling until 51% to avoid invisible moving saws. Stay at the ceiling until the end from there.
